status: retrospective methodological amendment; not a preregistration
scope: Saved-response results freeze for a human-authored manuscript. No new inference calls. Original manuscript and analyses are preserved.
labels: Original labels plus the previously defined drop, flip and damaged-text exclusions. No human audit is presumed. A completed audit creates a new version.
point_estimates: Retain the original log-linear correction per pass over items, enabling direct reconciliation.
resampling: Resample whole problems within split and label-composition strata. Keep all conditions and replies together. Use common resamples across critics sharing the same items.

claim_tests.method: Exact within-item conditional randomization for complete binary replies with fixed repeat counts; paired complete-response-vector swaps for equal repeats with parsing failures. Preserve the observed numbers of repeats. Exchangeability under the null is an assumption, not inferred from a timestamp.
claim_tests.adjustment: Holm within each original family; randomized p-values include the observed allocation.
claim_tests.intervals: Descriptive paired problem bootstrap intervals, separately labeled; not inversions of the randomization test.
claim_tests.equivalence: No revised population-equivalence conclusion is inferred from a zero-width or unvalidated percentile interval. Keep original equivalence classifications only as legacy results.

wording_tests.estimand: Difference in 10-to-90 criterion shifts. The shared positive reference d-prime scales the effect but does not alter the zero null.
wording_tests.method: Studentized centered problem-cluster bootstrap of the interaction, including wording main effects. Holm across all 60 slots. All four conditions are recomputed jointly.
wording_tests.fallback: Descriptive only if studentization is degenerate or fewer than 20 problems contribute a nonzero within-problem interaction in verdict or parse counts. Keep the slot in the correction family with p=1. Validation failure suppresses confirmatory wording conclusions, not the data.
wording_tests.equivalence: Legacy no-difference decisions are not promoted to revised equivalence claims.

ceiling: Keep the existing rule: 4 or fewer neutral errors per 200 makes rho descriptive only under that labeling.

threshold_evaluation.status: Retrospective problem-level cross-validation; all existing data have previously been inspected.
threshold_evaluation.transfer: Separate training on neutral scores and applying under a claim from training on the same claim wording.
threshold_evaluation.unit: Apply to individual replies; average within problem. Do not create a score ensemble.
threshold_evaluation.ties: Predict error iff score > threshold. Candidate thresholds -1 through 100; choose the smallest threshold among equal training risks.
threshold_evaluation.uncertainty: Full-procedure problem bootstrap with threshold selection repeated and duplicate copies kept in the same predetermined folds. Report percentile intervals as retrospective descriptive uncertainty, not new confirmatory tests.

interpretation: Gaussian SDT is a conditional reference model, not an identified optimum of actual critics
Effective probability is shift-equivalent, not an inferred internal belief
AUC concerns reported scores, not latent evidence
Declared randomness is confounded with attribution in the existing experiment
Any revised conclusion follows the data; no target significance count is imposed

audit_amendment.completeness: All 42 first-pass verdicts required; explicit unsure allowed, blank judgments rejected. Supersedes legacy partial-file fallback.
audit_amendment.assistance: Preserve independent first-pass CSV; later AI-assisted revisions or human adjudication in separate files with provenance.
audit_amendment.gap_only: Primary correct; secondary flawed. Report both.
audit_amendment.unsure: Exclude from audit-label estimates and disclose counts.
audit_amendment.reviewers: Separate snapshots per reviewer; no automatic consensus, no assistant counted as human.
